# docmubashirchaudhry Learning Portal

> Independent, free competitive exam preparation platform and solved study booklet archive curated by Doc Mubashir Chaudhry for PPSC, CSS/PMS, FPSC, and NTS candidates. Not affiliated with PPSC, FPSC, NTS, or any government commission.

## Primary Exam Preparation Hubs

- [Homepage Overview](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/): Curated study portal entry with quick search, recruitment post highlights, solved booklet cards, and MCQ launcher.
- [World Geography Reference & Active Quiz](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/geography): Verified reference guide and interactive quiz covering 250 sovereign countries and territories across 6 continents and 25 regions with ISO 3166-1 codes, capitals, ISO 4217 currencies, and official languages.
- [PPSC Recruitment & Past Papers Hub](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/ppsc): Punjab Public Service Commission exam posts paired with verified SHA-256 solved PDF booklets and explicit provenance labels.
- [All Exam Commissions Directory](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/exams): Published and upcoming Pakistan competitive examination commission hubs.
- [Interactive MCQ Practice Launchpad](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/mcq): Filterable one-paper MCQ drill builder across 9 canonical subjects and 10 syllabus topics.
- [Open Solved PDF Library](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/library): Direct downloadable solved study booklets with pre-verified byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, and rights statements.

## Verified PPSC Post Guides & Solved Booklets

- [Intelligence Officer (BS-14) PPSC Guide](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/ppsc/intelligent-officer): Official provenance notes and downloadable booklet links for PPSC Intelligence Officer screening.
- [Tehsil Sports Officer (BS-16) PPSC Guide](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/ppsc/tehsil-sports-officer): Post preparation details paired with Physical Education and General Knowledge booklet downloads.
- [Set 01 Intelligence Officer PPSC (BS-14) 500+ MCQs Details](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/library/resource/intelligence-officer-bs-14-set-01): Metadata, source citations, and verification details for the 2.63 MB (2,630,400 bytes) PDF resource.
- [Download Set 01 Intelligence Officer (BS-14) PDF](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/documents/ppsc/intelligent-officer/%28Set%2001%29%20Intelligence%20Officer%20PPSC%20%28BS-14%29%20500%2B%20MCQS%20By%20Doc%20Mubashir%20Chaudhry%20%281%29.pdf): Direct PDF booklet (500+ solved one-liner MCQs, 2,630,400 bytes).
- [TSO PPSC (BS-16) 500+ MCQs Details](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/library/resource/tso-ppsc-bs-16-500-mcqs): Metadata, source citations, and verification details for the 2.85 MB (2,852,491 bytes) PDF resource.
- [Download TSO PPSC (BS-16) PDF](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/documents/ppsc/intelligent-officer/TSO%20PPSC%20%28BS-16%29%20500%2B%20MCQS%20By%20Doc%20Mubashir%20Chaudhry%20%281%29.pdf): Direct PDF booklet (500+ Physical Education, sports rules, and GK solved MCQs, 2,852,491 bytes).

## Machine-Readable Datasets & Feeds

- [Dataset Version & Checksums Manifest](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/manifest.json): Canonical `datasetVersion`, schema version, record counts, and per-file SHA-256 checksums.
- [Authority Source Registry](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/sources.json): Primary official and open geodata references cited across records.
- [Sovereign Countries Reference JSON](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/geography/countries.json): All 250 published country and territory records with verification metadata.
- [PDF Resource Catalog JSON](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/resources/pdfs.json): Pre-computed byte sizes, SHA-256 digests, rights categories, and post mappings.
- [PPSC Recruitment Posts JSON](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/examinations/posts-ppsc.json): Structured post entities separating verified commission records from unverified entries.
- [PPSC Study Blueprints JSON](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/data/v1/examinations/blueprints-ppsc.json): Separated `officialSections` (`officialMarksPct: null` when unspecified) and `editorialTopicWeights`.
- [XML Sitemap](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable HTML URLs with `lastModified` timestamps.
- [Robots Policy](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawl directives allowing content routes and `/data/v1/` while disallowing `/api/`.

## Methodology, Verification & Governance

- [Content Verification Methodology](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/methodology): Explains `verified`, `unverified`, `disputed`, and `outdated` badges plus official-vs-editorial rules.
- [System Manifest & Live Record Counts](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/status): Human-readable build telemetry and dataset health overview.
- [Submit Corrections & Errata](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/corrections): Reporting path (`editorial@docmubashirchaudhary.com`) for factual or answer-key fixes.
- [Copyright, Attribution & Takedowns](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/copyright): Licensing rules (`author_original`, `public_domain_official`, `cc_by_4`, `permission_granted`).
- [About & Academic Leadership](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/about): Mission summary and academic profile of Dr. Mubashir Chaudhry.

## Optional

- [Accessibility Conformance](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 AA standards and keyboard/contrast notes.
- [Privacy Notice](https://docmubashirchaudhry.vercel.app/privacy): Zero login, zero ad trackers, and local-only quiz persistence disclosure.
- Legacy paths `/countries` and `/ppsc/{slug}/blueprint` issue HTTP 308 permanent redirects to `/geography` and `/ppsc/{slug}`.
- Unverified records carry explicit `unverified` labels in both visible UI badges and JSON responses until primary official gazettes or PDFs are attached.
